experiment_data.hypothesis: CLS function-level trained on ~447 samples (matching TRAJ variant count) should reveal whether TRAJ's lower accuracy (86.30% vs CLS 88.43%) is due to data volume disparity (34×) or formulation difference. If CLS@447 ≈ TRAJ → data volume is main confound; if CLS@447 > TRAJ → formulation effect independent of data volume.
